maxChars.description: Hard cap on the injected text across all providers. Exists because compaction is meant to shrink context: pasting a large block into the compaction prompt works against the thing it was called to do.

maxCharsPerProvider.description: Cap on a single provider's block, applied before the global one.

providers.description: Files whose contents should survive compaction. Nothing is enabled by default.

name.description: Identifies this provider. Layers merge by name, so a project config can override or disable an entry inherited from the global one.

path.description: File to read. ~ and $HOME expand. A * in the final segment is matched against the directory.

format.description: How to turn the file into text.

select.description: json only. Top-level keys to keep. The order is also the priority order: when a block must be reduced, the last entries are dropped first. Put what matters most at the front.

tail.description: jsonl only. How many trailing lines to keep.

pick.description: Which file to use when a glob matches several.

heading.description: Markdown heading above this block. Defaults to name.

enabled.description: Set false to keep an entry configured but inactive.

omit.description: json only. Keys removed wherever they appear, at any depth, applied after select. select only reaches the top level, and the weight in a state file is usually nested — a per-item narrative inside an array, say. Measured on one real session file, a single nested key was 91% of the document.

keep.description: json only. Keys that are never dropped or cut. When the block is over budget the other keys are dropped whole, lowest priority first, and if the protected keys alone still exceed the cap they are injected in full and the overflow is logged. Losing them is the failure this prevents, so overflowing is the lesser harm.

threshold.description: Compact before opencode would, on a threshold you choose.

enabled.description: Off by default. Triggering compaction is a real intervention, unlike appending text to a prompt.

at.description: Default trigger for models with no entry in modelLimits.

modelLimits.description: Per provider/model-id overrides, which win over `at`. Use these when you switch between models with very different context windows: a fraction that is safe on a wide window can sit below the floor a session settles at after compacting on a narrow one, and re-fire indefinitely.

model.description: provider/model-id to run the compaction on. null uses the session's model. Summarising is mechanical work, so a cheaper model usually does it fine.

cooldownMs.description: Minimum gap between triggers for one session.

toast.description: Show a TUI toast when it fires.

oneOf.description: Percentage of the model's context window, e.g. "60%".
Absolute token count, e.g. 120000. Independent of window size.
Fraction of the window, e.g. 0.6. Equivalent to the percentage form.
